title: Filipino Kare Kare with Reblochon
description: A modern twist on the classic Filipino dish, featuring tender ox tripe and vegetables in a rich peanut sauce, topped with melted Reblochon cheese.

ingredients.name: ox tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic; sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add ox tripe; cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add peanuts, kare kare powder, and palm sugar; stir to combine.
Add 1 cup water; bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until tripe is tender, about 1 hour.
Transfer to a serving platter; top with sliced Reblochon cheese.
